{{Quote|They found me out, did they? That's bad news for you, Rebel.|Lidek Baws on being discovered in the desert.|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Lidek Baws''' was a native of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] that was recruited into the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He was placed in their recruiting division and operated out of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. However, he was in fact a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and fed them information regarding Alliance [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. This leak was picked up by [[Hantor Loftus]], who sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to kill Baws and his overseers in the Tatooine desert.
